# Play — Knight Calls

- SudokuPad: [Knight Calls on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Knight Calls on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The anti-knight rule is exported as the standard f-puzzles constraint. Knight lines are exported as generic purple lines, so read
the rules text for their meaning. The centre loop is drawn as a line that returns to its starting cell.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints, solution).
